messages.subject: Granite — SPA negotiation strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Castle & Vane have come back hard on liability: 25% cap, 18-month limit, de minimis at £50k. My suggested landing zone:
- cap at 50% of consideration (defensible for a clean target with a 5% retention);
- hold the 24-month general limit;
- de minimis at £35k, aggregate threshold unchanged at £250k;
- reinstate the three-year non-compete.

The 'awareness' qualifier on the general warranty I'd resist — it guts the title and capacity warranties. Thoughts before I draft v3?

James

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Granite — SPA negotiation strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed on all of that. Push to 50% and keep 24 months — Edward was clear he wants meaningful recourse given the Northborough change-of-control point. Resist the blanket awareness qualifier but we can live with it on a few specific operational warranties if needed to close. Run the £35k de minimis past Fiona but it should be fine.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
